reviews.text: The trainer at Paws, Brian, was very patient with us and our puppy. He walked everyone through the class and guided how to do steps like increasing the duration and distance of obedience, and then moving onto adding distractions while being obedient.  This was the first level class. I highly advise that you try to attend all the sessions within the class to get your pup up to the level of obedience, that makes things work well for the pup and for you.
The trainer was very rude. Ive attempted to email and call and left voicemails and have not received any response. The training was just with the other dogs . Didnt even bother coming around to mine.

I highly recommend their classes for new pet owners, or people who want their dog to behave in a more predictable manner. It makes life better when you have a dog that knows right from wrong. The trainer’s here are great. They are knowledgeable and have patience. They show you examples with your own dog.

My husband and I took two different classes (Playful Puppies and Basic Obedience) with our two dogs adopted from Paws with trainer Brian, and both of us as well as our dogs really enjoyed the classes. Place is very organized and clean. Free easy parking on site is great. We learned a lot from the class materials and practices. Brian was also very knowledgable and skillful in personalizing training advice and techniques for each of our dogs. We really appreciate all of his help!

I paid for basic in class training the instructor did not want to interact with my dog because he’s a pitbull he told me to FaceTime his phone to do the class from home I tried to get a refund they told me I couldn’t because the classes already started
This is the first class we have taken at Paws Chicago Training Center it is a great facility and our instructor is great!  We are taking the AKC Canine Good Citizen Class

Sharon and the team here are exceptional!  The programs they offer and their staff are all excellent.  I highly recommend this organization to anyone looking to adopt, train, or just have fun with their pup.
